2.title: Director, Sales Strategy & Operations
2.excerpt: Improve forecast accuracy and pipeline health.

3.title: Business Development Representative - San Francisco
3.excerpt: Execute modern outbound prospecting strategies across phone, email, social, and video channels to generate qualified pipeline in greenfield accounts.

4.title: Senior FP&A Manager, GTM
4.excerpt: You will own the analytical backbone of how we plan, forecast, and measure our sales engine - this includes ARR and revenue forecasting, expense management, variance analysis and headcount planning.

6.title: Sales Strategy and Operations Manager
6.excerpt: Data visualization experience (Tableau, Looker, or PowerBI) is highly preferred.

7.title: Sales Strategy and Operations Manager
7.excerpt: High proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for financial modeling and compensation plan simulations.

8.title: HR Infrastructure & Operations Manager
8.excerpt: Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and SQL.
